name: crew
description: A coding crew of Claude Code sessions: live dashboard, progress bars, a kanban board loop, context limits and handovers

supervisor.title: Supervisor
supervisor.description: The session that coordinates the crew. It is never woken on idle, and members report to it.

members.title: Members
members.description: Crew member names, comma-separated, in dashboard order (for example: Ada, Grace, Linus). Leave empty to accept any name.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: The person who watches the dashboard and whose yes every push needs, as the prompts name them.

board.title: Board
board.description: mesh: members take work from an mcl-kanban board through the macula MCP server. off: no board; the dashboard, progress, limits and handovers still work.

realm.title: Board realm
realm.description: The realm your mcl-kanban board is served in, as 64 hex characters. Empty uses the macula MCP server's default realm.

worker_model.title: Worker model
worker_model.description: The model the crew launcher starts every session on, unless CREW_MODEL or the member's own entry in member_models says otherwise.

member_models.title: Member models
member_models.description: Per-member worker models, comma-separated name:model pairs (for example: Venus:claude-opus-5-5, Pluto:claude-sonnet-5-5). An OpenCode model (provider/model, e.g. Ceres:deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro) starts that member on OpenCode. Empty: every member runs on worker_model.

reviewer_model.title: Reviewer model
reviewer_model.description: The model review subagents run on: the crew mod sets it on every subagent whose type or description names a review.
